reviews.disposition: The material receipt closes selected M1–M6/PC43/G2 gates on an exact frozen build; it does not claim every material idea or normal-app adoption. Its route explicitly mixes named cooking/producer prerequisites with real native actions and fresh HP acquisition. Returned cargo, dirty apparatus and condition550 comparisons are synthetic prerequisites, not an earned return journey. Native Bonemeal-to-HP abrasion is a directional ORIGINAL law; reverse structural repair refuses, and names do not grant supernatural characteristic identity. Typed omissions, char versus wood origin, exact consumed/retained cohorts and actual search coverage matter. Budget8 is explicitly incomplete; small timings are descriptive, not performance thresholds. The full command failed 4 missing test inputs at 3452/3456; a six-file dependency supplement and exact affected 14/14 recovery do not rewrite that full command into PASS. PC43 6/6, I5 matrices, four roundtrips and source/asset manifests retain their separate build and inspection scopes. No additional cache/index/migration was justified. Static preview PID5921 was retained then, not live availability now; slot transfer and ended test workers do not prove installation.

reviews.disposition: The UI audit sampled a stepped lead action, DEV SEEDED fight and structured HP school candidate on isolated rebuilt bytes, not three earned normal-world journeys. Lead route had no reload/import; the center changing to Notebook was not causally isolated. Fight persistence excluded held-away minutes and covered failed withdrawal, not successful exit, healing or final settlement. Effects off was set by a hidden scripted control, proving displayed state rather than navigability. Preserve discovery-safe action ID conditions, reachable story seat, local clock provenance, payment versus debt reduction, known prerequisites versus hidden causes, honest risk wording, focus after redraw and removal of implementation notes/inactive odds. Compact rows versus timetable is a proposal, not accepted direction or comprehension proof. The later tracker supersedes selected October31 failures: L1 opening is agent-verified with three held later actions and 38 mappings still needing review; L2a interaction was verified before L2b, and the current L2b row records November4 DEV SEEDED floor proof. L2c final injury/witness, L3 observer/event, L4 school/form, L5 access/save and L7 mappings remain individually queued. The old ownership row calling L2b stopped at allowance is historical, not a current live-worker claim.
